title: Extending a morphism into a bounded below complex of injectives along a degreewise injective quasi-isomorphism
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian]. Let $K^\bullet$, $L^\bullet$ be bounded below cochain complexes of $\mathcal A$ (indexed by $\mathbf Z$, zero in all sufficiently negative degrees) and $\alpha:K^\bullet\to L^\bullet$ a morphism of complexes which is a quasi-isomorphism ($H^n(\alpha)$ an isomorphism for all $n$) and such that every $\alpha^n:K^n\to L^n$ is a monomorphism. Let $I^\bullet$ be a bounded below cochain complex whose terms $I^n$ are injective objects [def-sp-injective-resolutions], and $\gamma:K^\bullet\to I^\bullet$ a morphism of complexes. Then there is a morphism of complexes $\beta:L^\bullet\to I^\bullet$ with $\beta\circ\alpha=\gamma$.

source.place: Lemma Tag 013P (lemma-morphisms-lift, line 6386), part (2), stated here for bounded below K and L (Stacks does not need this; it is the case used)
